how: REA 6.10.1 + Ghidra 12.2 headless static analysis of the shipped program (read only, nothing run). One analysis per engine, shared by every game of the engine; addresses belong to the build named in sample and are re-found by signature in other builds

glyphRasterizer.note: the only caller of GetGlyphOutlineA: every glyph of the message window goes through it; the engine-level hook point candidate (decompile next)

choices.note: MSVC RTTI names: the choice menu is its own object with buttons (CSelectButtonManager), not text in the message window; reading the option texts and button rectangles from these objects replaces the OCR locate (next: xrefs of the vftables, decompile the button layout)

archives.note: only Config.pac is a literal; the other .pac names (Script.pac, Bgm.pac …) are built at run time

limits: each REA CLI command re-imports and re-analyses the program (about 190 s each): run the follow-up queries in one REA session (MCP) or decompile-all once and read the files
